name: ci-memory-agents-runner
description: Runs the CI memory experiment automatically through GitHub Copilot

ciMemory.agent.description: Name of the runs/<agent> folder to fill in

ciMemory.modelFamily.description: Copilot model family. Run 'CI Memory: List Available Copilot Models' and copy a `family:` value verbatim -- not the `id:`, which is a different field. Empty picks the first available, which must not be left empty when collecting real results: comparing conditions across different models would confound the experiment.

ciMemory.delaySeconds.description: Pause between runs, to stay within Copilot rate limits

ciMemory.maxRuns.description: Stop after this many runs. 0 means no limit.

ciMemory.allowRouterModel.description: Allow a model family whose id is 'auto' (Copilot's router). Off by default because the router may pick a different model per request, which confounds the comparison. Turn it on only when no pinned model is capable enough; every run records the model it actually received, and score_runs.py --mode report says whether it varied.
